tc.note: tP['tensorChar'] is the literal string cM assigned in KernelWriter._initKernel via getTensorParameters: 'A' for tensorParametersA, 'B' for tensorParametersB. These are the only two call-site values.

kernel[DirectToLdsA].note: True when DirectToLds==1 or DirectToLds==2 (Solution.py:722). False when DirectToLds==0 or DirectToLds==3. May be forced False by isDirectToLdsDoable() rejection or BufferLoad=False.

kernel[DirectToLdsB].note: True when DirectToLds==1 or DirectToLds==3 (Solution.py:723). False when DirectToLds==0 or DirectToLds==2. Same conditional reset logic as DirectToLdsA.

DirectToLds.note: YAML/MsgPack solution parameter. 0=no DTL (default, GlobalParameters.py:461), 1=both A+B, 2=A only, 3=B only. Drives DirectToLdsA and DirectToLdsB derivations.

predicate_coverage.true_branch: kernel['DirectToLds%s'%tc] is truthy: tc='A' with DirectToLds in {1,2}, or tc='B' with DirectToLds in {1,3}
predicate_coverage.false_branch: kernel['DirectToLds%s'%tc] is falsy: tc='A' with DirectToLds in {0,3}, or tc='B' with DirectToLds in {0,2}
